query_analysis.original_query: Develop a framework for optimizing the residence time in horizontal separators for maximized liquid dropout efficiency in high-pressure systems.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Create a systematic methodology for optimizing residence time in horizontal separators to achieve maximum liquid dropout efficiency under high-pressure conditions.

clarification_questions: What are the specific fluid properties (density, viscosity, surface tension) of the liquid and gas phases?
